subject: Request: Control evidence bundle and SIG mapping for procurement review
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@globex.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: David Brooks <david.brooks@globex.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Control evidence and SIG mapping for procurement review

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for taking this. Procurement at Globex is moving our security review to the final stage and we need a consolidated "evidence bundle" for the vendor security team. At a minimum they have asked for:

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period) and SOC bridge letter if available
- ISO 27001 certificate and scope statement
- A completed SIG questionnaire (we can also accept a SIG-lite mapping)
- Network diagram showing where customer data is processed
- KMS/key management summary and any HSM/KMS vendor attestations
- Sample audit logs showing account provisioning/change events for the last 6 months (redacted PII is fine)
- Data retention and deletion policy excerpts

If possible, please provide these as a single downloadable bundle (secure link) and include a short manifest with filenames and brief descriptions. Procurement would like this by EOD next Tuesday (2026-04-21) to keep the procurement pipeline moving. Also let me know if anything requires an NDA or additional entitlements to view.

Appreciate it — happy to jump on a quick 20-min call if helpful.

Best,
Alice Nguyen
Senior Security Analyst, Globex Corporation
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@globex.com>
Cc: David Brooks <david.brooks@globex.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2026 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Control evidence and SIG mapping for procurement review

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver a consolidated evidence bundle and a SIG mapping. High-level plan below:

1) Today: share a preliminary SIG mapping workbook (attached) and confirm which date ranges/formats you need for logs.
2) By Mon 2026-04-20: final SIG mapping + redacted SOC 2 Type II + ISO cert + network diagram + KMS summary + sample logs uploaded to secure link.
3) Tue 2026-04-21 EOD: one consolidated manifest + any follow-up Q&A.

Attachments: prelim-sig-mapping-20260415.xlsx (prelim mapping for your review).

A couple quick questions: do you need native log files (CSV) or an exported summary? Also, is the procurement team able to access files delivered via our secure Share-Transfer link (expires 7 days) or do you need SFTP transfer?

CC'ing our security owner and SE to scope artifacts and redaction: Marissa Cole (security) and Karthik Iyer (SE).

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@globex.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: David Brooks <david.brooks@globex.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Control evidence and SIG mapping for procurement review

Thanks Rishi — CSV exports are preferred for the logs (timestamped events, actor, event_type, resource), redacted where necessary. The procurement team can access files via your Share-Transfer link; please ensure the link allows auditors (we'll add two external reviewers).

Also: for SOC 2, they want the testing period covered (start/end dates) and any carve-outs noted. If you have a short attestation explaining the scope of your ISO cert (which services/infrastructure are included), that would be helpful.

I'll plan to review the prelim mapping and revert if there are gaps.

Best,
Alice
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Control evidence and SIG mapping for procurement review

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Globex's ask (see chain below). They want a single evidence bundle by EOD Tue 4/21. Please own the package and redaction. Key asks from procurement:

- SOC 2 Type II (most recent), scope and any bridge letter
- ISO 27001 cert + scope statement
- Completed SIG mapping (we have preliminary attached)
- Network diagram (high level; mark customer data processing zones)
- KMS policy summary + vendor attestations (if any HSM involvement)
- Audit log samples: CSV format, last 6 months; redact PII but keep timestamps/actor/action
- Data retention excerpts

Action items:
- Marissa: produce redacted SOC2 PDF, ISO cert, network diagram, KMS summary, audit log extracts. Note any artifacts that require legal signoff to share. Indicate transfer method (Share-Transfer link vs SFTP).
- Karthik: finalize SIG mapping and confirm any product configuration notes to call out in manifest (e.g., caching defaults, retention controls).

Please add estimated delivery ETA for each artifact and attach drafts when ready to this thread. I will coordinate with procurement for access permissions.

Thanks — Rishi
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2026 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Control evidence and SIG mapping for procurement review

Thanks Rishi. I will own packaging and will deliver the following artifacts to the secure Share-Transfer link (expires in 7 days) unless procurement requests SFTP:

- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025_redacted.pdf  (redacted PII, Includes testing period 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31)
- Redwood_ISO27001_2024_Cert.pdf (cert + scope statement)
- network_diagram_v2.png (annotation: customer data processing zones highlighted)
- kms_policy_summary.docx (1-2 page summary + vendor attestations)
- audit_log_samples_2025_q3-q4.csv (CSV, redacted user identifiers, includes timestamp, actor_type, event, resource)
- sig_mapping_final_20260417.xlsx (finalized SIG mapping workbook)
- evidence_manifest.txt (simple manifest with filename -> short description)

Notes and exceptions:
- SOC 2 Type II: we will provide a redacted PDF. We cannot share raw auditor testwork or certain vendor contracts; if procurement needs that, we'll discuss a redaction review or execute a restricted NDA.
- Audit logs: we will provide representative samples rather than full log archives to limit scope — procurement indicated samples are acceptable. If they need a longer retention span, we'll coordinate pagination and SFTP transfer.

ETA: I will upload prelim artifacts by Mon 2026-04-20 11:00 PST and finalize manifest by Tue 2026-04-21 09:00 PST. Karthik, please confirm when you can deliver the final SIG workbook so I can include it in the bundle.

—Marissa Cole
Director, Information Security, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@globex.com>, David Brooks <david.brooks@globex.com>
Date: Sat, 17 Apr 2026 15:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Control evidence and SIG mapping for procurement review

Hi all — final SIG mapping is attached and I'll include a short "control notes" sheet with product configuration references (retention TTLs, caching behavior, key rotation cadence). Attachment: sig_mapping_final_20260417.xlsx.

Marissa — confirm once you upload and I'll post a short README in the manifest describing how each file maps to SIG control identifiers (for procurement ease).

Alice / David — once Marissa confirms upload I will drop access instructions here and we can arrange a 20-min walkthrough if you want to review the network diagram and KMS notes.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
